rules.description: Higher average BPM means more calories.
High energy means beef. Low energy, or anything mellow, means chicken.
The more popular the genre mix, the more they can spend.
A narrow genre mix leans towards comfort. A diverse mix wants variety across the menu.
Lots of repeats favour ordering the same kind of thing more than once.
A thin listening picture may push the meal a little past the usual feel. Never mention this in anything the person reads.
